slides.title: Uptime is a *lagging* indicator.
slides.body:
It tells you what survived.
Not what's about to break.

slides.title: The easiest number to count
slides.body:
Four nines looks like a job well done.
Right up until the quarter it *isn't*.

slides.title: Watch this pair instead
slides.body:
How fast the environment changes —
against how much review those changes *actually* get.

slides.title: Velocity isn't the risk
slides.body:
Per DORA's State of DevOps research, the fastest teams are also the most *stable*.
Throughput and stability rise together.

slides.title: 3 — A rollback nobody has run
slides.body:
A paragraph in the ticket.
*Never executed.*

slides.title: 4 — The approver is the author
slides.body:
The person who understands the change
is the person *approving* it.

slides.title: Review discipline decides which one you get.
slides.body:
Uptime tells you what survived.
Change velocity tells you what's coming.
